messages:
sophia: heads-up: converted GemmaX-6.7B to our qwen-compat int4 preset and saw a deterministic drop on the arithmetic microbench when prompts include a trailing newline before an EOS sentinel.
max: can you show a minimal repro and the converter CLI args?
sophia: minimal repro: tokenizer -> vocab_shrink -> convert_weights with grouped int4. failing prefix: 'Prompt:\n' + EOS inserted by harness. converter args:
```
./convert_weights --src gemmax6b --dst qwen-compat --quant int4 --grouped 16 --preserve-eos --rotary-base auto
```
run: `python run_eval.py --model converted.pt --suite math-micro --prompt tests/prefix_newline.txt --seed 1234`
alice: auto rotary_base picking 2048 instead of GemmaX's 10000?
sophia: exactly. forcing --rotary-base 10000 -> math accuracy returns to baseline. auto selection seems to break phase alignment for certain token boundaries.
max: do we see this only with vocab shrinker enabled?
sophia: yes, when we skip shrinker the auto heuristic chooses a different base and issue vanishes. with shrinker + grouped int4 we get small per-head gain drift.
eval-bot: run 2025-02-11-09: bench math-micro median 0.89 (fp16) -> 0.66 (int4-auto-rotary, converted).
alice: log dumps? per-head stats?
sophia: conversion log excerpt: "rotary_base: auto -> 2048"; head_mean_ratios show several heads ~1.003-1.006 vs fp16. kv-cosine-diff trace shows divergence after ~7 tokens when prefix ends with '\n'.
max: sounds like frequency mapping derived from token frequency histogram got skewed by removed tokens in the shrinker. that would shift computed base -> phase misalignment on subtoken boundaries.
alice: can we calibrate per-head after quant to remove the gain skew? any quick patch?
sophia: quick hack: run a tiny calibration corpus (100 short examples) and compute scale[h] = mean_fp16_kv[h] / mean_int4_kv[h], multiply int4 head weights by scale[h]. re-run eval -> accuracy climbs back to ~0.86. not perfect but much better.
max: is this observed on Llama or Mistral conversions too?
sophia: I tried Llama->qwen quick path: no repro. Mistral shows smaller regression but only with shrinker+grouped int4. GemmaX seems most sensitive.
alice: mitigation for rollout: add converter flag --force-rotary-base and disable int4-auto for GemmaX families until we implement per-head calibration in Optimize. also add CI test: prefix-with-newline should be in our regression suite.
sophia: opening ticket with run artifacts, logs, per-head dumps, and propose adding per-head affine rescale step to conversion pipeline. will attach the small repro set and the temporary calibration script.
eval-bot: ticket RIN-5483 created and linked to failing run 2025-02-11-09.
max: thx. let's add a unit test in the eval harness that runs through all convert presets with the newline+EOS edge case. catches this earlier.
sophia: on it. :thumbsup:
